generation.prompt: Vertical orthographic camera directly above: overhead top-down view of a cramped spaceship industrial processing bay, top surfaces only, axis-aligned rectangular machines, no perspective side faces. Left: a large square cream-coloured volatiles refinery machine with a round dark crucible glowing orange-hot in its top, a small inspection window with bronze bars, a hatch and vent grille, brass corner bolts. Centre-right: a smaller square chemical processor (water electrolysis cell) with a tall pale-green cell panel, one grey-white oxygen sphere and one copper-orange hydrogen sphere, with pipes running to a long dark grey horizontal hydrogen storage tank wrapped with orange bands at the right. A green oxygen canister rack beside it. Bottom: open crates of dark ore chunks and stacked grey metal ingots, a floor drain, yellow-black hazard stripes. Grey steel deck plates, dark wall panels at edges, blue equipment lockers, restrained industrial colours: cream, charcoal, slate blue, amber, copper orange. Chunky readable pixel art, crisp dark outlines, no text, no people.
